item.text: The write API already converts controller errors to HTTP 400. I found a cross-database atomic counter pattern in the existing `locks` object, so I’ll use it to acquire a per-user or per-session posting lock and release it in `finally` for both topic creation and replies.

The lock now covers creation and replies, so overlapping writes from the same actor get a 400 while the accepted request is processing. I’m checking the counter cleanup and controller formatting before running the existing topic tests.

Implemented `lockPosting` in [topics.js](/app/src/controllers/write/topics.js). Topic creation and replies now use an atomic, per-user or per-guest-session lock; overlapping requests receive HTTP 400 with `bad-request`, and the lock is released after processing.

ESLint passes. The existing topic test could not run because Redis at `127.0.0.1:6379` was unavailable. The checkpoint is at `.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md`.
